Fix: **Set `ignore_mismatched_sizes=True` and use `strict=False` when loading, OR save only the classifier weights, OR reload the model architecture consistently.**

title: improve - 347d68bc
method: The script implements a multi-stage ensemble for 3-class authorship attribution. Data preprocessing includes a stratified train/validation split (80/20). Feature engineering extracts 26 stylometric features, 4 readability features, 5 POS approximation features, and n-gram TF-IDF features (char n-grams 2-7, word n-grams 1-3, punctuation n-grams). A DeBERTa-v3-large model is fine-tuned for up to 40 epochs with early stopping (patience=5), using AdamW optimizer, linear warmup schedule, label smoothing, gradient clipping, and mixed precision (AMP). After fine-tuning, CLS embeddings are extracted. Three classifiers are trained: (1) the fine-tuned DeBERTa, (2) XGBoost on combined stylometric+embedding features, and (3) Logistic Regression on n-gram sparse features. An ensemble weight grid search optimizes the weighted average of all three models' probability outputs based on validation log loss.
